scores.visual_critic_note: Deliberately designed dark-theme explorer with consistent CSS-variable palette, clean typographic hierarchy (uppercase muted panel labels, bright title), and well-proportioned multi-panel grid layout — held back from 8 by the dense, undifferentiated network graph where node labels are too small to read and the blue-on-dark encoding blurs into noise at this render size.
scores.encoding_integrity_note: Zero baseline on bar chart, scaleSqrt used consistently for all circle-size encodings (network nodes and color scatter), data-driven domains throughout; minor: timeline y-axis domain is fixed to full-data max and does not recalculate on filter subset, technically failing the subset relation invariant but intentionally preventing axis jumping.
scores.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces rendering, but O(n) bitFilter.set() and bitFilter.filtered() run synchronously on every brush mousemove event (not deferred), risking jank at 34k blocks; no D3 transitions means zero mid-flight snap risk; pointer events API prevents mouse-touch fight; no cross-view feedback loops detected.
scores.cognitive_load_note: Four linked crossfilter views is a manageable pattern and the monochromatic network palette controls color overload, but the 60-node force layout reads as a loose hairball in the screenshot and the dense thumbnail wall at the bottom offers no comparison structure — both push past warning thresholds without enough mitigation.

proposer: 4 compactions: removed extra blank line, inlined `maxCount`, inlined `minWeight`, replaced `flatMap` with `filter+map`. All purely mechanical — no behavior changes. Should be ~953 lines.
